properties.name: Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia
properties.description: Strategic US naval and air base in the Indian Ocean providing power projection across the Indo-Pacific and Middle East.

properties.name: Ramstein Air Base
properties.description: Headquarters of USAFE-AFAFRICA and NATO Allied Air Command, key hub for European and Middle East operations.

properties.name: Camp Humphreys
properties.description: Largest US overseas military base, headquarters of USFK and Eighth Army south of Seoul.

properties.name: Yokosuka Naval Base
properties.description: Home port of the US 7th Fleet and the only forward-deployed carrier strike group outside the US.

properties.name: Andersen Air Force Base
properties.description: Strategic bomber base on Guam supporting continuous bomber presence and Indo-Pacific power projection.

properties.name: Al Udeid Air Base
properties.description: Forward headquarters of CENTCOM and AFCENT, the largest US air base in the Middle East.

properties.name: Incirlik Air Base
properties.description: NATO air base in southern Turkey with nuclear weapons storage capability and Middle East strike access.

properties.name: Camp Lemonnier
properties.description: Primary US military base in Africa, supporting counterterrorism and drone operations across the Horn of Africa.

properties.name: Pituffik Space Base (Thule)
properties.description: Northernmost US military installation providing ballistic missile early warning and space surveillance.

properties.name: Naval Station Norfolk
properties.description: World's largest naval station and home port for the US Atlantic Fleet carrier strike groups.

properties.name: Kaliningrad Military District
properties.description: Russian Baltic exclave hosting Iskander missile systems and the Baltic Fleet, threatening NATO's eastern flank.

properties.name: Sevastopol Naval Base
properties.description: Home port of the Russian Black Sea Fleet in occupied Crimea, heavily degraded by Ukrainian strikes.

properties.name: Tartus Naval Facility
properties.description: Russia's sole Mediterranean naval base providing logistics support and power projection in the Eastern Med.

properties.name: Fiery Cross Reef
properties.description: Chinese artificial island military outpost in the Spratly Islands with a 3km runway, radar, and missile systems.

properties.name: Mischief Reef
properties.description: Chinese-built artificial island within the Philippine EEZ, equipped with hangars, radar, and CIWS systems.

properties.name: Subi Reef
properties.description: Chinese military outpost in the Spratlys with fighter-capable runway and surface-to-air missile emplacements.

properties.name: Yulin Naval Base, Hainan
properties.description: China's primary submarine base with underground pens housing nuclear-armed SSBNs for second-strike capability.

properties.name: Changi Naval Base
properties.description: Singapore's primary naval installation at the eastern entrance of the Strait of Malacca, hosts US carrier visits.

properties.name: Pine Gap Joint Defence Facility
properties.description: US-Australian SIGINT and satellite surveillance station providing missile early warning and intelligence collection.

properties.name: HMNB Clyde (Faslane)
properties.description: Home of the UK's Trident nuclear deterrent submarine fleet and the Royal Navy's submarine service.

properties.name: Kadena Air Base
properties.description: Largest US Air Force base in the Pacific, hosting F-15s and ISR assets on Okinawa facing the Taiwan Strait.

properties.name: Naval Support Activity Bahrain
properties.description: Headquarters of US Naval Forces Central Command and the US Fifth Fleet overseeing Persian Gulf operations.

properties.name: PLA Support Base Djibouti
properties.description: China's first overseas military base, located near Camp Lemonnier, supporting PLAN operations in the Gulf of Aden.

properties.name: Ream Naval Base
properties.description: Chinese-funded and operated naval facility in Cambodia providing PLA Navy access to the Gulf of Thailand.

properties.name: Misawa Air Base
properties.description: Joint US-Japan air base in northern Honshu hosting F-16s and intelligence collection operations.
